hard_gates: Never enable a candidate unless source hashes and environment switches prove runtime reachability.
Use VLLM_CACHE_ROOT, not only TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR, to isolate or intentionally share vLLM AOT caches.
Do not include engine initialization or first-use packing/JIT in steady-state throughput; report them separately.
Do not promote a weight-exact path as stock-token-exact without paired output evidence.
Do not extrapolate a batch-1 winner to higher concurrency.
global_optimum: NOT_PROVEN. The policy is the best measured member of the bounded local portfolio. The BF16 batch-1 route is now automatically derived from two strictly guarded runs per implementation plus a veto-only historical baseline envelope. Architecture-level decoding, load-time checkpoint formats, broader prompts, sampling, sequence lengths, power-locked repeats, other GPUs, and future vLLM releases remain open dimensions.
